descriptions.root: The overall structure of this expression.
descriptions.variable: The variable {name}. Its value can change.
descriptions.frac: Fraction — the top (numerator) divided by the bottom (denominator).
descriptions.sqrt: Square root — the number that gives this value when squared.
descriptions.sum: Summation — add up the general term as the index runs through its range.
descriptions.product: Product — multiply the general term as the index runs through its range.
descriptions.integral: Integral — the area under the curve of a function.
descriptions.limit: Limit — the value an expression converges to as the variable approaches a given point.
descriptions.abs: Absolute value — the magnitude with the sign ignored.
descriptions.overline: A symbol with an overline. It denotes a mean, a conjugate, a closure, and so on.
descriptions.chem: Chemical notation representing substances and reactions.

specialVariables.eulerE: The natural constant e (about 2.718). It underlies exponentials and calculus.
specialVariables.imaginaryI: The imaginary unit. i squared is -1.

operators.=: Equals sign — the two sides are equal.
operators.<: Inequality — the left side is less than the right.
operators.>: Inequality — the left side is greater than the right.
operators.≤: Less than or equal to — the left side is at most the right.
operators.≥: Greater than or equal to — the left side is at least the right.
operators.≠: It states that the two sides are not equal.
operators.∈: Membership — the left side belongs to the set on the right.
operators.→: Implication — the condition on the left leads to the conclusion on the right.
operators.⟹: Implication — the condition on the left leads to the conclusion on the right.
operators.∪: Union — take every element of both sets.
operators.∩: Intersection — keep only the elements common to both sets.

functions.sin: Sine function — a trigonometric function; in a right triangle, opposite over hypotenuse.
functions.cos: Cosine function — a trigonometric function; adjacent over hypotenuse.
functions.ln: Natural logarithm — the logarithm with base e.
functions.exp: Exponential function — a power of e.
functions.det: Determinant — a scalar characteristic value of a matrix.
functions.max: The function that takes the maximum value.
functions.min: The function that takes the minimum value.

hat.description: A hat denotes an estimate or a unit vector.

widehat.description: A hat denotes an estimate or a unit vector.

vec.description: An arrow marks a vector, which has both magnitude and direction.

overrightarrow.description: An arrow marks a vector, which has both magnitude and direction.

overleftarrow.description: An arrow marks a vector, which has both magnitude and direction.

dot.description: A dot denotes a derivative with respect to time. In physics it is used for velocity and the like.

ddot.description: Two dots denote a second derivative with respect to time, such as acceleration.

tilde.description: A tilde denotes an approximate value or a transformed quantity.

widetilde.description: A tilde denotes an approximate value or a transformed quantity.

bar.description: A bar denotes a mean value or the conjugate of a complex number.

superscriptOnly.description: Power — the base multiplied by itself as many times as the exponent says.

subscriptOnly.description: Subscript — it picks out a particular element or component.

both.description: A symbol carrying both a superscript and a subscript.

withLeft.description: Notation with scripts on both sides of the symbol.

formula.description: Notation that writes a substance out in element symbols.

equation.description: It shows the substances on the left turning into the substances on the right.

species.description: One of the substances taking part in the reaction.

element.description: A symbol standing for an element of the periodic table.

group.description: A cluster of atoms enclosed in parentheses that behaves as a single unit.

coefficient.description: The ratio of particles taking part in the reaction. It is the number that balances the atoms on both sides.

count.description: It says how many of the preceding element or group are present.

charge.description: The size of the charge an ion carries. It equals the number of electrons lost or gained.

chargeSign.description: It says whether electrons were lost, giving a cation (+), or gained, giving an anion (−).

massNumber.description: The protons and neutrons in the nucleus added together. It distinguishes isotopes.

atomicNumber.description: The number of protons in the nucleus. It determines which element this is.

arrow.description: It shows that the reaction proceeds in the direction of the arrow.

equilibriumArrow.description: The forward and reverse reactions run together and reach equilibrium.

condition.description: The catalyst, temperature, pressure, and other conditions the reaction needs.

plus.description: It joins the substances on the same side. It is not addition.

hydrate.description: It shows that water molecules are held inside the crystal.

state.description: It says which state the substance is in: solid (s), liquid (l), gas (g), or aqueous solution (aq).

gas.description: It shows that the reaction gives off a gas.

precipitate.description: It shows that the reaction forms a solid that settles out.
